SLAMMED! is worth buying, and if you're like me, you'll be on the edge of your seat sinking a few hours into this game. Every moment feels tense, every victory feels deserved, and you become so invested in the world you don't expect a swerve until it comes right at you.

By the end, I felt like I just finished a good-no-great book written with passion. Sure, I'm still hung up on missed opportunities, fractured relationships, 'What-could-have-been', but that's the beauty of this medium: You can go back and do it all over again.

It wasn't until recently did I ever appreciate what went into professional wrestling - this addition of the "Choice of..." anthology only cements pro wrestling place as a form of entertainment and an art. 

Well written with much thought put into the consequences of one's actions, SLAMMED! puts on a spectacle while also showing what goes on beneath the surface. Its author, Paolo Chikiamco, shows his love for the sport very clearly in the span of 4-5 hours to get from beginning to end - only to entice to you read again and see how things could play out differently. Slammed! is an interactive story based in the world of professional wrestling. You don't need to know or understand professional wrestling, although some terms are crucial to understand (ie, the concept of kayfabe) and a quick google search every now and then will help as you go along. At its core though, this is a story about your journey and the personalities that you interactive with - the wrestling is the backdrop for the most part.

The story's pacing is excellent, and the blurring of the line between real and kayfabe (which is broadly the same concept as the "fourth wall" in acting) is really well done. The quality of the writing, purely from the point of view of the storytelling, is also excellent. For me, the best example of this is the section that features the "promotional video" for the grand finale, where the writing got me genuinely pumped up for the big climax.

There is a reasonable amount of replayability - there are enough branching story arcs for you to play several times and not get bored of it. The choices feel meaningful, and there are several possible finales and many different journeys you can take on the way to them.

Highly recommended.

[i][b]"Shows you how it feels to put on your own wrestling shoes."[/b][/i]

SLAMMED! is a fully text-based story telling game where you play as a wrestler from an independent wrestling circuit. You mold your own personality either if you're the fan favorite or the infamous villain. You choose your own wrestling style, your "FRIENDS", your TRUE "FRIENDS". The story will throw you to the point of whether you should show the REAL you or keep the character mask you're playing. You'll also be given a choice of whether you'll make the match turn to a real beatdown fight or an entertaining match. 

Just always remember that in wreslting, [i]"Sometimes, you need to lose in order to win."[/i]

If you're a big wresling fan and you want a much better storyline than that of what the WWE makes today? Then you should try SLAMMED!. And don't worry, SLAMMED! is more likely part of the Attitude Era of the WWE. After playing this game, you'll realize how crappy the WWE's storylines are today.

Highly recommended.
